prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. Squat rectangular equipment flight case, dull dark gray panels with silver aluminum edges, two black metal latches and one recessed handle, one replaced corner fitting and old cream tape patch. .7x.55tile footprint, height25px at tile144. Closed lid, no logo, no text. Hand-painted broad metal highlights. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent, without a background tint/glow or ground. Localized hand-worn areas, uneven small repairs and stable readable silhouette; not systematically scratched everywhere.
